messages:
elaine (Finance): Heads-up: Helios Bio flagged a big jump in their Nov invoice after they shifted some workloads to 'auto-scale nodes' in their private deployment. They say platform fees should apply to their committed GPU-hours (per MSA), not raw node-hours. Can ops + legal triage for a provisional true-up?

omar (AE): I got a note from Priya (customer billing). She attached the invoice and said they only changed orchestration type for staging clusters. They're worried churn if we don't respond quickly.

sasha (Solutions): Quick diagnostic: their cluster resource labels switched and our metering started emitting metric_key=node_compute_hours for that account. Our ETL treats node_compute_hours as billable usage by default.

billing-bot: Invoice 992201 created for HLS-321. Invoice total: $98,100. Line: Platform fee = $18,300.

sasha (Solutions): Ran a metering aggregate for Nov:

```
SELECT sum(node_hours) AS n FROM metering.events
WHERE account = 'HLS-321' AND ts BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2024-11-30';
-- n = 9,720 node_hours
```

Using Helios commit mapping (commit = 3 x A100 equivalent) -> gpu-hour equivalent ~= 3,000 gpu_hours. Recomputed platform fee under committed basis comes to ~$7,700.

elaine (Finance): So delta ~ $10.6k? We can approve provisional credits < $15k without director sign-off. Please compute precise delta and open a credit request.

matt (CustSuccess): I'll tell Priya we'll acknowledge within 24 hours and issue a provisional memo while you audit. She appreciates quick fixes.

sasha (Solutions): Final numbers: node-based platform fee = $18,300; committed-equivalent platform fee = $7,700; delta = $10,600. I documented the conversion, linked internal mapping: /internal/billing/committed-mapping/helios-2024-11.md, and raised infra ticket to apply fallback mapping for accounts with active commits.

elaine (Finance): Opening provisional credit CR-2024-772 for $10,600, to be applied to Invoice 992201 as "platform fee reconciliation provisional credit". Will tag as reversible after audit.

zoe (Legal): I reviewed Helios_Bio_MSA_2023. Section 4.2 references 'Committed GPU capacity' and doesn't list node-hours. Good to provisionally credit while we confirm. I'll draft a one-paragraph confirmation to the customer noting provisional status and reversal conditions.

billing-bot: Credit request CR-2024-772 created. Status: pending_approval.

elaine (Finance): Please attach the customer's invoice PDF and any commit docs to the credit request. Also include reference CM-2024-301 for the provisional credit memo once approved.

omar (AE): Uploaded invoice_pdf and the customer's commit confirmation email. Customer agrees to provisional memo while they pull their infra logs.

sasha (Solutions): Action items: 1) PR to billing ETL to apply node->gpu conversion when account has commit flag (I will add test vectors); 2) add alert to detect metric_key changes for committed accounts; 3) finish internal audit within 3 business days.

matt (CustSuccess): Marking the account with a revenue risk flag until final reconciliation. I'll follow up with Priya after you issue the provisional memo.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2024-301 issued for $10,600 against Invoice 992201. Status: PROVISIONAL.

elaine (Finance): Approved provisional credit. We'll keep this thread updated with audit findings; if mapping is validated in our favor, we'll reverse the CM and bill the customer for the small differential. Thanks team.

zoe (Legal): Sent draft note to Priya and copied Omar.

omar (AE): Customer update planned for EOD today.

sasha (Solutions): PR and alert created: infra/PR#584, monitoring alert ID: METRIC_KEY_CHANGE_HLS-321.

elaine (Finance): Closing action for now; will re-open if audit changes the numbers.
